name: New Zealand
summary: The National–ACT–NZ First coalition faces a Labour-led opposition. National leads Labour 32% to 27% in the latest 1News–Verian poll (15–19 Oct), with Luxon ahead of Hipkins as preferred prime minister.

parties.name: National Party
policies: Raise default KiwiSaver contributions from 3% to 6% by 2032
Make KiwiSaver compulsory and auto-enrol newborns
Low-interest loans for home solar, batteries and insulation
Scrap good-character sentencing discounts for sexual offending

parties.name: Labour Party
policies: Repeal the Regulatory Standards Act within 100 days
Cap public transport fares at $20 a week in major cities
Create a NZ Future Fund
Free cervical screening for women aged 25–69

parties.name: Green Party
policies: Wealth tax, inheritance tax and higher corporate tax
Build 40,000 social homes in five years
Revoke fast-tracked mining consents
Mass electrification and renewables

parties.name: ACT New Zealand
policies: Cut government spending and merge ministries
Deport serious non-citizen offenders
Let pharmacists treat more conditions
Split-gas emissions target

parties.name: New Zealand First
policies: Break up energy companies to cut power prices
Turn supermarket duopoly into two cooperatives
Merge BNZ with Kiwibank as a Crown bank
Referendum on the Māori electorates

parties.name: Te Pāti Māori
policies: Abolish prisons by 2040 in favour of community solutions
Parliamentary Commissioner for Te Tiriti with veto powers
Contest general as well as Māori electorates

parties.name: The Opportunity Party
policies: Replace welfare with a means-tested citizen's income
Land value tax to bring down house prices
Citizens' assemblies on major issues
